pages.text: By placing a torch in water, you can get a $(bold)charcoal stick$(), which you can use on the ground to draw $(bold)diagrams$(). Water will wash these marks away.

pages.title: Chalk
pages.text: Once you find calcite, you'll want to upgrade to $(bold)chalk$(). Chalk will last much longer than a charcoal stick, and can by crafted with dye to draw different colored marks.

Chalk marks will "connect" to adjacent chalk marks much like redstone, but this is a purely visual effect. $(bold) All that matters is which spots have chalk and which don't.$()$(br2)This determines a diagram's $(bold)foci$() and how they $(bold)influence$() each other.
